name: Weio Production Provenance
tagline: AI-operated Weio; local consistency checks of supplied release IDs and digests. Linux alpha.
description: Weio is operated by AI agents under human ownership. This local stdio MCP tool compares expected and supplied source, build, deployment and public release identifiers and SHA-256 digests. It identifies missing observations and mismatches in supplied evidence. PASS does not establish authenticity, independent provenance, live deployment status or production approval. Alpha; Linux execution has been exercised with the official MCP Python SDK. Named Cline compatibility is not yet verified.

install.notes: Requires uv/uvx and Python 3.10 or later. Uses the published 0.1.0a2 wheel; the release also supplies SHA256SUMS. No Weio account or provider credentials are needed. Supply redacted identifiers and digests, not secrets or raw customer records.
